name: URY admin setup wizard
describe: Setup wizard full-page card, no admin shell (WizardLayout): header with logo, title and two-step breadcrumb, a Card with the setup form (/setup-wizard/0) or the Configure sidebar and Branch section (/setup-wizard/1), and the sticky footer navigation.
First-run flow after install: Setup collects company, country and installation type; Configure walks branch, rooms, tables, menu, payments and staff.
